business_problem: Telefónica Spain needed a more accurate and efficient way to plan rural fiber deployments because conventional planning tools struggled to predict optimal routes, physical obstacles, required resources, and realistic costs, which increased planning complexity, human error, and civil-works expense.
solution_summary: Telefónica España implemented an internally developed AI system based on genetic algorithms to automate and improve fiber network planning in rural areas. Planning teams feed the model proportionate geographical coordinates, network design criteria, historical cost information from similar deployments, prior deployment patterns, urban-density context, and information about physical obstacles and reusable infrastructure. The AI evaluates route alternatives, designs an optimal deployment path, and produces preliminary estimates of resources and cost, including the effect of reusing existing assets and minimizing civil works. The resulting plans are consumed by planning and engineering teams early in the project lifecycle to align estimates with execution reality, reduce error, and support more autonomous, data-driven planning under Telefónica's Autonomous Network Journey program. The source does not name a separate storage or serving platform beyond this internal AI workflow.
data_flow: Planning teams supply geographical coordinates, network design criteria, historical deployment-cost data, obstacle context, urban density, and existing infrastructure information to an internally developed genetic-algorithm AI. The model evaluates route options, estimates resource needs and cost, and returns optimized deployment plans and cost scenarios to Telefónica's planning teams for execution decisions and future customer cost inquiries.
integration_points: Geographical coordinates for target deployment areas
Historical cost data from previous deployments
Existing infrastructure data used to assess reuse
Planning and engineering teams consuming route and cost estimates
Customer inquiries about deployment costs in specific locations
business_outcome: Telefónica España says the AI has transformed fiber planning by reducing human error, improving control over cost estimates, optimizing resource allocation, accelerating service availability, and reaching Level 4 autonomy in the fiber planning process, with potential to improve customer response times for deployment-cost inquiries.
metrics: level 4 autonomy in the fiber planning process
